geometry: Two white folder silhouettes: a tabbed rear panel and a slanted front panel separated by a transparent gap, with short curved corners. Native canvas is 48 by 48 pixels; source alpha bounds are (2, 4) to (48, 44).
limitations: Smooth diagonals and corners approximate the source's rasterized edges. Position and scale were tuned against the original; the updated 8x rendering was inspected.
